{{Hatnote|This is the dated constructed pool of December 2011 – May 2012. For the fixed pre-reset pool played since 2014, see [[Legacy Open]]. For all pools of this era, see [[Virtual Legacy#Constructed pools|Virtual Legacy]].}}
'''Premiere - Virtual Block 7.4''' is the constructed card pool of every Decipher card plus the [[Players Committee]] virtual cards through [[Ultimate Legacy (Virtual Block 7)|Virtual Block 7.4: Ultimate Legacy]]. The Players Committee released 7.4 on 16 December 2011; the PDF has official text as of the same day.<ref name="j328">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=328&catid=1&Itemid=117 Virtual Set 7.4 Released!], Players Committee (16 December 2011). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20120215235118/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=328&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pdf74">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf ''Virtual Block 7: Ultimate Legacy''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of December 16, 2011". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174533/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> No tournament-legal date was found. Decklists of the [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (10–12 February 2012) use 7.4 cards such as [[Hindsight (V)]] and [[Mace Windu, Master Of The Order]].<ref name="ev-2012 Match Play Championship">Decklists of the [[2012 Match Play Championship]] on this wiki.</ref> The pool lasted until Virtual Block 8.1 (official text 11 May 2012) became legal; that date is unknown.<ref name="pdf81">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf ''Virtual Block 8: Scoundrels''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of May 11, 2012". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020185537/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf?copy=2 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee's name for its constructed format until 2014 was ''Standard'': the 25 July 2014 announcement that replaced this pool was titled "Reset of Standard Format" and said that "The new Standard tournament format will consist of all post-reset V Cards".<ref name="reset">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/reset-of-standard-format/ Reset of Standard Format], Players Committee, Advocate Council (byline darkjediknight11) (25 July 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20141020142523/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/wp/reset-of-standard-format/ Internet Archive]</ref> "Legacy" was created only then, for the pre-reset cards.

* '''Type:''' constructed
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee
* '''Card pool:''' every Decipher card plus Virtual Blocks 1–6 and Virtual Block 7.1–7.4
* '''In use:''' December 2011 (released 16 December; legal date unknown) – May 2012
* '''GEMP:''' none (GEMP's ''Legacy'' environment is the later fixed pool, [[Legacy Open]])

== Card pool ==
The pool is every Decipher card plus every Players Committee virtual release up to and including [[Ultimate Legacy (Virtual Block 7)|7.4 Ultimate Legacy]]:

* Every card printed by Decipher.
* The earlier numbered Virtual Sets 1–17, including [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields|Defensive Shields]], as realigned in 2009 into [[Virtual Block 1|Virtual Blocks 1–5]].<ref name="vb1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf ''Virtual Block 1''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of December 7, 2009". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="w-reorg">[[2009 Virtual Block Reorganization]]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 6]] release [[Reflections IV (Virtual Block 6)|6.1 Reflections IV]] (110 cards).<ref name="w-r4">[[Reflections IV (Virtual Block 6)]]</ref><ref name="pdf61">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf ''Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of September 4, 2009". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> Seventeen of the Legacy [[Virtual Shields]] were printed in this release.<ref name="vshields">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf vshields.pdf], Players Committee (2013). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180941/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf Internet Archive]; see [[Virtual Shields]]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 6]] release [[Domain Of Evil (Virtual Block 6)|6.2 Domain Of Evil]] (26 cards).<ref name="w-doe">[[Domain Of Evil (Virtual Block 6)]]</ref><ref name="pdf62">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf ''Virtual Block 6: Domain Of Evil''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of December 7, 2009". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 6]] release [[Mercenaries (Virtual Block 6)|6.3 Mercenaries]] (34 cards).<ref name="w-merc">[[Mercenaries (Virtual Block 6)]]</ref><ref name="pdf63">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf ''Virtual Block 6: Mercenaries''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of March 15, 2010". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174429/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 7]] release [[Ultimate Power (Virtual Block 7)|7.1 Ultimate Power]] (48 cards).<ref name="w-up">[[Ultimate Power (Virtual Block 7)]]</ref><ref name="pdf71">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf ''Virtual Block 7: Ultimate Power''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of June 18, 2010". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 7]] release [[Ultimate Freedom (Virtual Block 7)|7.2 Ultimate Freedom]] (28 cards).<ref name="w-uf">[[Ultimate Freedom (Virtual Block 7)]]</ref><ref name="pdf72">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf ''Virtual Block 7: Ultimate Freedom''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of December 15, 2010". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180935/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> Three more Legacy [[Virtual Shields]] were printed in this release.<ref name="vshields" />
* [[Virtual Block 7]] release [[Ultimate Conflict (Virtual Block 7)|7.3 Ultimate Conflict]] (43 cards).<ref name="w-uc">[[Ultimate Conflict (Virtual Block 7)]]</ref><ref name="pdf73">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf ''Virtual Block 7: Ultimate Conflict''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of June 3, 2011". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020184809/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf?copy=2 Internet Archive]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 7]] release [[Ultimate Legacy (Virtual Block 7)|7.4 Ultimate Legacy]] (22 cards).<ref name="w-ul">[[Ultimate Legacy (Virtual Block 7)]]</ref><ref name="pdf74" />

Changes made while this pool was in force:

* 11 April 2012: "April CBT Errata" from the Competitive Balance Team. Only the headline survives in the preserved copies used here; which cards changed is not recorded on this page.<ref name="hp201205">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org home page], Players Committee (Latest News list: "April CBT Errata", 11 April 2012; "Scoundrels 8.1 Annoucement", 14 April 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20120510015711/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ Internet Archive, 10 May 2012]</ref>

== History ==
Ultimate Legacy closed Block 7 with 22 cards (12 Dark Side, 10 Light Side).<ref name="w-ul" /> On 14 April 2012 the Players Committee announced Block 8, Scoundrels, which "seeks to help make decks that feature these fringe element see more playing time while also shifting the overall meta away from big decks like Communing and Hunt Down V".<ref name="j335">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=335&catid=1&Itemid=117 Scoundrels 8.1 Annoucement], Players Committee (14 April 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20120818111311/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=335&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref>
